title: Mantel-Haenszel and Peto meta-analysis in the browser: a tool validated against the R package metafor
description: Paper 10 MH/Peto validation archive v1.1.0, prepared against allmeta v1.8.0 (1cb3f8409c7af75ed41f7e1811f9c502f900fc79; 10.5281/zenodo.23515177), release run 2026-10-20 against allmeta 1cb3f84. Retains the original 68,461-check protocol and 106 tail checks and adds PR #159 heterogeneity, CMH/Tarone/Breslow-Day, leave-one-out and conventions validation against metafor 5.2-1 and meta 8.5-0. Extras contract: 120,000/120,010 (10 documented failures) and 3,793/3,793 text claims. Fresh browser-to-Python and browser-to-R checks passed 68,461/68,461 plus 106/106 tails; extras measured 120,000/120,010 (10 documented metabin-reml-refusal, 0 unexpected), with claims 3,793/3,793. Evidence: provenance/run_plan-2026-10-20-release.log. Historical results are retained separately.
